questions.stem: What is the GCD of 48 and 18?
questions.explanation: The Euclidean algorithm gives: 48 = 18 \times 2 + 12, 18 = 12 \times 1 + 6, 12 = 6 \times 2 + 0. The GCD is the last non-zero remainder, which is 6.
